children: Context Therapeutics’ net loss narrowed year over year in 3Q 2026 as research and development costs fell, mainly because CT-202 contract manufacturing and preclinical expenses declined. Lower interest income partially offset the improvement.
² Reported as “Net loss”. ³ Reported as “Net loss per common share, basic and diluted”.
: The company discontinued internal development of CT-95 and is prioritizing CTIM-76 and CT-202.
: Phase 1a data for the Q3W trial are expected in the second quarter of 2027; Phase 1b dose expansion is anticipated to begin in the first quarter of 2027.
: The first patient in the Phase 1 trial was dosed in September 2026; initial Phase 1a data are expected in the second half of 2027.
: Cash and cash equivalents of $34.4M at September 30, 2026 are expected to fund operations to early fourth quarter of 2027.
